SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN 'web' ELSE 'store' END AS ch,
       COUNT(*) AS line_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_receipt_lines,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net,
       MIN(f.sale_date) AS min_sale, MAX(f.sale_date) AS max_sale,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s999,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 OR f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
GROUP BY 1

WITH w AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.sale_date AS order_date_line,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS order_date,
         o.status, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key AND s.store_id=900
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
    AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-25' AND DATE '2026-08-20'
      OR CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02')
)
SELECT 'by_dispatch' AS basis, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS orders, SUM(net_amount) AS net, COUNT(*) AS n_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_order_row,
       SUM(CASE WHEN order_date<>order_date_line THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS line_date_ne_order_date
FROM w WHERE dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'by_order_date', COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), SUM(net_amount), COUNT(*),
       SUM(CASE WHEN status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
       SUM(CASE WHEN order_date<>order_date_line THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM w WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'status_' || COALESCE(status,'null'), COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), SUM(net_amount), COUNT(*), 0, 0
FROM w WHERE dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY status

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount,
         CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900
              THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
              ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date,
         s.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, '1-3' AS fiscal_periods_covered,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT l.receipt_id), 2) AS atv,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.store_id=900 THEN l.receipt_id END) AS web_orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.store_id=900 THEN l.net_amount END) AS web_net,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN l.store_id<900 THEN l.net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.store_id<900 THEN l.receipt_id END),2) AS store_only_atv
FROM lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year

WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-05-04' AS d0, DATE '2026-08-02' AS d1),
test_keys AS (SELECT product_key FROM dim_product WHERE category = 'ZZ Test'),
store_lines AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, 0 AS is_web
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  CROSS JOIN params
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
    AND f.product_key NOT IN (SELECT product_key FROM test_keys)
    AND f.sale_date BETWEEN params.d0 AND params.d1
),
web_lines AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, 1 AS is_web
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  CROSS JOIN params
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
    AND f.product_key NOT IN (SELECT product_key FROM test_keys)
    AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN params.d0 AND params.d1
),
all_lines AS (SELECT * FROM store_lines UNION ALL SELECT * FROM web_lines)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year,
       COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), 2) AS atv,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_web=1 THEN receipt_id END) AS web_orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_web=1 THEN net_amount END) AS web_net,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_web=0 THEN net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_web=0 THEN receipt_id END),2) AS store_only_atv
FROM all_lines

WITH st AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'),
wb AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-20' AND DATE '2026-08-20'),
ctl AS (
  SELECT SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS ctl_gross, SUM(receipts) AS ctl_receipts,
         SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN net_sales_before_returns END) AS ctl_store_gross,
         SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN receipts END) AS ctl_store_receipts,
         SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_sales_before_returns END) AS ctl_web_gross
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND store_id<>999)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM st) AS store_receipts,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM st WHERE receipt_id IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM wb)) AS overlap_ids,
       ctl.* FROM ctl
